kind: ordinary static raw-byte delivery map; no qualification receipt
reassembly: Read segments in the recorded order and concatenate bytes without delimiters. Segments split only at original line boundaries. All original stdout/stderr, notices, errors, duplicates and exits remain; zero-byte completed logs are intentional.
configMeaning: Configuration copies preserve the original cwd and relative path meaning and are snapshots, not runnable configurations at the delivery location.
